title: Sub-location entrances for major quest sites (the Hundred Gallery in Cinderhall, the Drowned Nave in Fenmarch, the Kings' Rest in Hollowbrook) were not discoverable by exploring nearby rooms directly — only a specific NPC's 'bearings'/dialogue line gave exact directions ('north four, then east one'), and I wasted 30-60 turns wandering undifferentiated spoil/mound/reed rooms before finding the right NPC to ask.
